name: writing-versions
goal: A revision that declares writing 2 holds each attempt of a reason to 15 words; one that declares 1 keeps 20. The version comes from the revision a reason explains, never from its date.

evidence: Prior behaviour: one set of writing limits, declared as writing 1, with each attempt of a reason at 20 words; a revision is held to it when its own verification config declares it. Requirement from Daniel through the coordinating task: each attempt at most 15 words, versioned as writing 2, while revisions and notes of writing 1 keep 20. Root of the gap: the limits are one constant, the config schema accepts only the literal 1, and a side carries a boolean, so a stricter limit could only be applied to every revision at once or to none. Evidence read: src/utils/writingLimits.ts, ExplanationService, ReasonPathService, runExplain, loadRevisions, verifyTypes, CommitMessageService. Commit message limits are the same in both versions, so their staged-index and per-revision activation stays as it is.

Commands, on the unchanged implementation at f0c387f: npx vitest run test/utils/writing-policy.test.ts test/services/explanation-versions.test.ts: 9 failed, 1 passed (RED-units.log). npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism test/explain-versions.e2e.test.ts test/writing-activation.e2e.test.ts: 4 failed, 1 passed (RED-e2e.log). Defect assertions: under writing 2 the CLI stores a 16 word attempt (exit 0 where 1 and 'the limit is 15' are expected); a 16 word note put in by hand passes explain check; a whole-range note ending in writing 2 content is accepted with 16 words; harness verify refuses a config that declares writing 2. The two tests that pass are the writing 1 compatibility cases, which must stay green. Logs and sha256 of the four test files: control directory writing-v2-qa-scripts.

Repair: writingPolicy(version) gives the limits of version 1 or 2, which differ only in attempt words (20, 15); writingHeld(config) reads the version a revision declares; each side of a comparison carries that version; ExplanationService.report judges the reasons it relies on by the version of the head side of the comparison they satisfy, so every step of a walked range is judged by its own revision and a whole-range reason by the head; explain add holds a new reason to the version of the revision it explains; the config schema accepts 1 and 2. Nothing reads recordedAt. Guard: the four new test files, the two end-to-end ones added to test:e2e, plus a fault-reintroduction run in a throwaway copy.

src/utils/writingLimits.ts: writingVersions, writingVersion 2, writingPolicy(version) with attempt words 20 and 15, writingHeld(config), writingDeclared kept as a boolean, explanationProblems(reason, version). verifyTypes accepts writing 1 or 2. ReasonSide and RevisionSide carry the declared version; ExplanationService.report and ReasonPathService judge by the head side of each comparison; explain add holds a new reason to the version of the head of its range. harness.verify.json declares 2. Guard wired into normal verification: two new files in test:e2e in package.json, two in the unit glob. commitMessage.ts, CommitMessageService, src/index.ts and the shared index are untouched.

Unit and service files unchanged since red (sha256 checked): writing-policy, explanation-versions and the earlier writing-limits file, 15 passed (GREEN-units.log). End to end: writing-activation 1 passed and explain-versions 3 of 4 passed unchanged (GREEN-e2e.log); the fourth, the range of both versions, passed its behaviour and failed one expectation of mine: explain check prints the number of changes, 1, not of notes. That one line was corrected and the file passes 4 of 4 (GREEN-e2e-versions.log); the record of that range relies on a 20 word and a 15 word note. The red of the final files is rerun as REINTRODUCED-original in the guard step. Final hashes: frozen-test-hashes.sha256.
